Preset: features MAAS+MATA parity. Dark section, one --dark card + one --light card, 5-slot bullet list per card.

TWO PLATFORMS, ONE CONNECTED WORKFLOW

Better insight for stronger execution

MATA - Analytics

Transform data into trading intelligence

Turn cross-asset insight into actionable pre-trade intelligence, helping you evaluate execution decisions before you move.

  • Quantify expected execution costs before commitment
  • Compare strategies side by side to evaluate potential outcomes
  • Explore interactive outlier views to focus on higher-risk or harder-to-trade orders
  • Monitor market conditions and portfolio exposures
  • Model scenarios across asset classes
MAAS - Execution

Drive stronger performance outcomes

Turn trading insight into disciplined execution, with advanced technology designed to adapt as market conditions change.

  • Access adaptive algorithms built for live market conditions
  • Select AI-powered strategies tailored to execution objectives
  • Route orders intelligently to help minimize market impact
  • Support consistency across asset classes through shared execution logic, connected workflows and platform-wide controls
  • Benchmark performance against pre-trade expectations

Variant -- data-animate (fires when scrolled into view)
Scroll down ↓

Eyebrow · fadeInUp · 0ms

Heading · fadeInUp · 120ms

Body · fadeInUp · 240ms. Each element starts hidden and plays once when it enters the viewport. The eyebrow / heading / description cascade is the pattern every section uses.

Variant -- data-stagger-parent (children play in sequence)
Scroll down ↓

Parent: data-stagger-parent="fadeInUp" data-stagger-step="150". Children need no attributes.

Card 10ms
Card 2150ms

Variant -- other animate.css effects
Scroll down ↓

Any animate.css name works in data-animate. These are the ones worth reaching for.

fadeIndata-animate="fadeIn"
fadeInUpthe default
fadeInDowneyebrows, heroes
zoomInuse sparingly
fadeInLeftsplit layouts
fadeInRightsplit layouts
slideInUpno fade
flipInXprobably don't
Variant -- data-animate-duration / data-animate-delay
Scroll down ↓

Default duration is 1.3s. Override per element with data-animate-duration (ms).

Fastduration 400
Defaultduration 1300
Slowduration 2500
Delayeddelay 800
